title: Tenma Saki — Fun, Happy Music〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do our best again during practice today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You've been so full of energy since this morning, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because Jam Fest is just around the corner! We gotta practice harder than usual in order to get ready for it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it is important for us to stay focused.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, it's happening soon...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It always felt so far off...
But after practicing day in and day out, it sort of creeped up on us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, Ichi, I totally get what you mean!
I was also surprised when I realized that it was just a few days away!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I felt the same thing as well.
But doesn't that go to show how much we've been able to focus on practicing?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We only have one song left in the set list to work on, so I think we've been having productive practices.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, let's keep doing our best to really master it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It's full steam ahead until the festival...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've been practicing so much that I think we've forgotten about something really important...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, what are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is what I mean! We haven't packed yet, right?!

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, do we need to bring anything special with us...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nothing out of the ordinary, I think?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've gotten everything together that we usually need for our shows, so I don't think we need anything special...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we do! Lots of things!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is our first big festival!
So, we gotta have all our ducks in a row!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, so what else do we need?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uhh... Oh!
An outdoor venue usually means lots of bugs!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, we gotta take bug repellent and stuff! What if a big swarm comes and causes us to lose focus while we're playing?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If it's an area where bugs like to gather, then I'm sure that the venue staff will have countermeasures in place.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo didn't mention anything regarding that, did he?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm talking about just in case!
Because some of us like to have backup plans in place!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What else is there...? I know!
We might wanna take some medicine with us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why medicine?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if we get so nervous that we drink too much water and get stomach aches?! Who knows if there's going to be a hospital nearby?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm not sure we'd be able to play anyway, if it's bad enough we would have to go to the hospital...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess it's true nerves can cause stomach pain, but—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna put on the best show we can, so we should have all our bases covered!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Should we bring neck pillows with us so we can sleep during the trip over? What about blankets in case it's chilly in the green room!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How much luggage do you plan to bring?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're not going on vacation or anything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I do sort of understand how you feel, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have to prepare for every show we do, but this is an especially big event. As such, it's natural for us to feel nervous.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that nervousness is going to be our Achilles' heel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. If possible, I'd like for us to play like we normally do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, we should do what we can to ensure that we do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Agreed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, we may want to take that other thing with us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! What other thing?! Tell me!
